$comment: Resolution-only view of the workspace for dependency-cruiser (.dependency-cruiser.cjs). Not part of the real build — it is never referenced from tsconfig.json and TypeScript itself never reads it. Each package's own tsconfig.json is the source of truth for what that package may resolve; this file exists only because dependency-cruiser's tsconfig-paths resolution reads a single merged paths table rather than following per-package tsconfig 'references' the way tsc and Vite do. Every entry here is the union of the per-package 'paths' already declared across packages/*/tsconfig.json — see those files, not this one, for the real per-package boundary.
